class_name: 対象-関連-ニマツワル類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

patterns.usage_note: Names what clings to something: the tales, legends, superstitions and memories attached to a place, object or name, most often with 話, 伝説, エピソード, 逸話. It implies no dispute, unlike をめぐる: 遺産にまつわる話 against 遺産をめぐる争い. It appears almost entirely in the prenominal form にまつわる, and it adds a narrative air that the flatter に関する lacks.

examples.ruby: この古[ふる]い井戸[いど]にまつわる伝説[でんせつ]を祖母[そぼ]から聞[き]いた。
examples.english: My grandmother told me the legend attached to this old well.

examples.ruby: お金[かね]にまつわるトラブルで友人[ゆうじん]と疎遠[そえん]になった。
examples.english: A falling-out over money left me estranged from a friend.

examples.ruby: 名前[なまえ]にまつわるエピソードを面接[めんせつ]で話[はな]した。
examples.english: At the interview I told the story behind my name.
